reason: I only move this kind of money through my Indian bank's NRI desk or a big bank branch. A new app I have never heard of sitting in the middle of lakhs of rupees is not something I will risk, even if the fee is small.
objection: What if the transfer gets stuck halfway or the CA rejects something? Then my money is sitting in limbo with a company I do not know, and a refund of their fee does not get my money back.
would_change_my_mind: My own Indian bank or a big Canadian bank vouching for them, or a few people I know in the community who have already moved a large amount with them without trouble.
